documents.title: Return Policy
documents.body: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase when the order record is available.

documents.title: Support Hours
documents.body: Standard support hours are Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM local business time.

documents.title: Security Retention Policy
documents.body: Audit logs are retained for 90 days. Access review records are retained for one year.

documents.title: Billing Export Guide
documents.body: Billing exports include invoice id, account id, billing period, amount, status, and currency.
